x: We think of the superb Club track men such as Tommy Scrimshaw, Jim Tosh, George Dunckley, Eddie Pack, Cooper-Clark, Len Herbert; together with Bert Footer, Arthur Penny, Jim Ginty, Tom Carter, Les Cohen, Pat Parker, the Flowers, Jack and Joe, Arthur Allum.
Cooper Clark, one time 440 and 880 yards Club Champion, was recently spotted in Vienna by Alf Harley. Cooper is now a corporal in the R.A.F. and sends his best wishes to all his old friends.

Odde, a newcomer to the club, who reminds us very much of J. Cooper Clark, our old club champion, and we hope that with further experience Odde will gradually improve and he may yet find that a half-mile will be his best distance.
